decisions.reason: Premium support remains closely tied to existing service operations and costs little to retain, so its real option value justifies keeping it open while residual demand uncertainty remains.
The version management tool builds on established technical expertise and has low marginal keeping costs, so the option is retained even though its stand-alone visibility has fallen.
Scalable hosting for agencies is a flagship product line aligned with the firm's core hosting business, making it a strategic option with low uncertainty and strong reason to keep investing.
